body:
GitHub issue #106: packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs declares PHASE_REQUIREMENTS.p4 = ['rails-green', 'rails-check', 'flail-check']. Only rails-guard --record ever emits 'rails-check'. Neither 'rails-green' nor 'flail-check' is emitted by any shipped tool, so `adlc run p4 --ticket <id>` can never pass from any documented flow — every harness integration that treats it as a P4 confirmation step is pointing at an unsatisfiable assertion.

Note: this ticket was originally authored as T151, then re-minted as T153 after an id collision with PR #390 (T150/T151). A second, independent T153 collision (this time with the reviewer-directed-comments distill ticket, PR #516/#517-era work) surfaced on this rebase — re-minted again as T158 (no code/test content referenced either superseded id).

'rails-green' has no tool backing it anywhere in this repo (confirmed via full-repo grep) and was never wired up since the very first commit that introduced PHASE_REQUIREMENTS (9fd66d5) — it predates and duplicates the invariant 'rails-check' already covers (rails-guard's clean-diff proof). The already-shipped harness docs (plugins/adlc-opencode, adlc-pi, adlc-cursor's adlc-verify-build.md, fixed under the already-closed issue #105) instead record a generic 'p4-build' entry via `adlc gate-manifest record p4-build --ticket <id> ...` as the real evidence that build/lint/targeted-tests were green. That is the established, working convention for 'the build is green' evidence — reuse it instead of inventing a new mechanism.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs` gains a `--record` (boolean) and `--ticket` (string) flag. On a clean (non-flail) verdict with `--record` passed, it appends a `flail-check` manifest entry via `@adlc/gate-manifest`'s `appendManifestEntry`, mirroring `packages/rails-guard/bin/rails-guard.mjs`'s existing `--record` pattern (record only on a clean pass; ticket is optional metadata on the entry, not required to run the check itself). Verification: `packages/flail-detector/test/*.test.mjs` covers (a) a clean verdict + `--record` writes a `flail-check` entry with the ticket and log evidence (logHash checked against a real recomputed sha256, not just non-empty), (b) a flail verdict + `--record` writes nothing, (c) `--record` without `--ticket` still records (ticket null), matching rails-guard's optionality, (d) `--help` documents both flags.
2. `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs`'s `PHASE_REQUIREMENTS.p4` changes from `['rails-green', 'rails-check', 'flail-check']` to `['p4-build', 'rails-check', 'flail-check']`. Verification: `packages/runner/test/runner.test.mjs` fixtures/expectations referencing `rails-green` are updated to `p4-build` (using `gate:`, not `type:`, matching the real shape `gate-manifest record()` produces), individual single-marker-omission cases exist for all three markers, and an end-to-end CLI test spawns the real rails-guard/flail-detector/gate-manifest binaries and asserts `adlc run p4 --ticket <id>` exits 0 once all three are recorded.
3. `packages/flail-detector/README.md` AND its generated mirror `docs/tools/flail-detector.md` document the new `--record`/`--ticket` flags (flags table + an example + updated `--help` synopsis), and the "Core Gaps" section no longer claims "no ledger writes" now that `--record` exists.
4. `plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/adlc-verify-build.md`, `plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-verify-build.md`, AND `plugins/adlc-opencode/command/adlc-verify-build.md` each record real `flail-check` evidence (`adlc flail-detector <log-file> --scope <glob> --record --ticket <id>`), and no remaining text claims `adlc run p4`/`adlc-runner run p4` always fails once the three markers are recorded. (opencode's doc previously never invoked flail-detector at all — found and closed during P5 prosecution, since leaving one of three shipped harnesses structurally unable to satisfy P4 would leave the issue only partially fixed.)
5. Full test suite passes (`npm test` from repo root) and `npm run preflight` passes (including mutation-gate).

## Known follow-up (filed separately, out of scope here)

P5 prosecution (3 independent lenses) confirmed that `p4-build` and `flail-check`, once made load-bearing P4 requirements, get only bare-presence checks in `assertPhase` — no staleness/content verification analogous to `rails-check`'s `p4IntegrityErrors` (railFiles hash pinned to the current worktree). This matches the existing rigor level of every OTHER phase-1/2/3/7 marker (spec-lint, premortem, coldstart, merge-forecast, hollow-test, rails-red, rails-frozen, lesson-foundry, rejection-mining, skill-rot are all bare-presence too), so it is not a regression introduced by this ticket, but it is a real gap now that P4 is genuinely satisfiable for the first time. Tracked as a follow-up rather than expanded into this ticket, which is scoped to making the assertion satisfiable, not to adding new verification machinery.

## Non-goals

- Not inventing a real 'green targeted test run' tool distinct from the existing `p4-build` generic-record convention — that would be new scope beyond what #106 asks for.
- Not touching P3's `['rails-red', 'hollow-test', 'rails-frozen']` (same unsatisfiable-marker defect, but out of scope for issue #106, which is P4-only).
- Not adding staleness/content integrity checks for `p4-build`/`flail-check` (see Known follow-up above).
title: Make 'adlc run p4' satisfiable: flail-detector --record + drop orphaned rails-green
